messages.subject: International executive profile | Thailand, Eastern Seaboard and ASEAN leadership
messages.body:
Dear JAC Recruitment Thailand Team,

I am reaching out for senior Thailand and ASEAN searches where international industrial experience, government relations and ESG leadership are relevant.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ year career spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current responsibilities cover government and regulatory engagement, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

JAC's strength across industrial, oil and energy, environmental services, logistics and the Eastern Seaboard makes your Thailand team especially relevant. I am targeting Director, Head, Country Representative, Country Director, External Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability and Strategic Partnerships mandates.

I am open to Bangkok, Chonburi, Rayong and regional ASEAN assignments. I have attached a JAC-focused executive CV for your review and would value an exploratory discussion with the consultant best aligned to senior industrial and energy searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
